name: assimp
license: BSD-3-Clause AND CC-PDDC AND MIT AND BSL-1.0 AND Unlicense AND Zlib
scope: three vertices and one triangular face from ASCII PLY
family_note: C and C++ Assimp APIs share the same native PLY loader.

name: rply
scope: three vertex callbacks and three face-index callbacks from ASCII PLY
family_note: C and C++ adapters link the same pinned RPly C core; the C++ adapter calls its documented extern C API.

name: assetkit
input_api: ak_load(&doc, local filename, AK_FILE_TYPE_AUTO); ak_meshFromGeometry; ak_meshPrimitiveIndexAccessor
scope: three vertices and one triangular face with parsed indices from ASCII PLY
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same AssetKit C API and native PLY importer.

name: sply
input_api: ply_open(local ASCII PLY filename); ply_read_header; ply_set_read_cb; ply_read
scope: three vertex callbacks and one parsed triangle face with indices
family: SPly fork of RPly ANSI C parser
family_note: SPly 1.2.0 is a separately tagged MIT library package with custom-I/O and locale changes, fully compatible with RPly; shares the RPly parser lineage and C callback API.

name: msh_ply
scope: ASCII PLY triangle: three parsed vertex coordinates and one face with final index 2
family_note: Standalone versioned header at a pinned upstream commit. It is a distinct reader from RPly/SPly and Assimp; its benchmark is project-authored and is not treated as a popularity metric.

name: f3d
scope: ASCII triangle produced three parsed points and one cell
family: F3D native PLY plugin over VTK vtkPLYReader
family_note: C, C++, and Java F3D 4.0.1 bindings share the F3D native plugin and VTK 9.7.2 vtkPLYReader syntax parser.

name: mdal
scope: Three parsed vertices, one face and face indices
family: MDAL PLY driver over bundled libplyxx
family_note: MDAL uses its native PLY driver over a fork of libplyxx; distinct package path from the other C PLY readers. The public C ABI is called through pinned C declarations because upstream mdal.h itself is not C11-compatible.

name: cybermesh
input_api: cmg_read_plc(local .ply path); cmg_plc_num_points; cmg_plc_num_triangles; cmg_plc_points; cmg_plc_triangles
scope: ASCII PLY three parsed vertices, one triangle, coordinate and face indices
family: CyberMeshGenerator native ASCII PLY reader through its C ABI
family_note: The C ABI wraps the project's C++ ASCII PLY parser. This is a released package path but has no comparable Homebrew metric; GitHub stars at review time were zero and are only auxiliary project-interest evidence.

name: brlcad
input_api: gcv_context_init; find_filter(GCV_FILTER_READ, BU_MIME_MODEL_PLY, local filename); gcv_execute; rt_db_get_internal
scope: three vertices, one face, triangle indices and BRL-CAD default scaled coordinate from local ASCII PLY
family: BRL-CAD gcv-ply plugin over bundled RPly 1.1.4
family_note: Distinct BRL-CAD library package and import API; bundled RPly is the underlying syntax parser family already represented by standalone RPly and SPly.

name: ops_pointcloud
scope: ASCII PLY point cloud subset: three parsed vertex coordinates; faces are not exposed by the point-cloud API
family: Open Pointcloud Studio native Rust PLY reader through ops_pointcloud C ABI
family_note: One LGPL point-cloud core with C ABI; distinct package and syntax reader from the other C PLY paths. The local C adapter uses the official released SDK binary.

name: pdal_c
input_api: PDALCreatePipeline(JSON readers.ply with local filename); PDALExecutePipeline; PDALGetPointViews; PDALGetPointViewSize
scope: ASCII PLY point-cloud subset: three parsed points through explicit readers.ply stage; no mesh exposed in this view
family: PDAL native PLY reader via pdal-c C API
family_note: pdal-c is a separately released BSD-3-Clause C API wrapper over PDAL 2.10.2. The underlying syntax parser is PDAL readers.ply; do not count it as an independent engine from PDAL.

name: blukpast
input_api: bkpLoadPly(GPU adapter, local PLY path, BkpModel output, scratch group); harness captures parsed geometry at GPU upload boundary
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle with three parsed positions and face indices; upstream syntax parser with GPU upload replaced by observation harness
family_note: Distinct tagged C package with native PLY syntax parsing. The harness replaces only GPU upload and model storage calls; no full Vulkan engine is built. This row is a source-level C API replay, not a GPU integration test.

name: pcc
input_api: pcc_point_cloud_init; pcc_point_cloud_t.read_from_file(&cloud, local PLY path); cloud.positions and cloud.size
scope: Three parsed point coordinates from one valid ASCII PLY triangle; face not exposed by point-cloud API
family: PCC C facade over bundled miniply C++ PLYReader
family_note: Distinct tagged GPL C API package. Its PLY syntax parsing delegates to bundled miniply C++ source. The unrelated codec source requires zstd.h even when USE_ZSTD=OFF, so the replay compiles only the unmodified local PLY call path. miniply also underlies separately recorded Python pyminiply and pyvista-miniply paths.

name: pcprep
input_api: pointcloud_load(pointcloud_t *, local PLY filename) returns success; cloud.size and cloud.pos contain parsed points
scope: Three parsed point coordinates from one valid ASCII PLY triangle; no face data exposed by this API
family: pcprep C facade over bundled miniply C++ PLYReader
family_note: A distinct released C library package from filrg. It shares bundled miniply C++ parsing with PCC and separately recorded Python paths. The exact GitHub release tag is pcprep-v1.0, while its CMake version is 1.0.1.

name: mccode
input_api: McStas Guide_anyshape(geometry=local ASCII PLY path) component parameter; generated C calls off_init into off_struct
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle; C runtime parsed three vertices and one polygon and computed 1.0 by 1.0 bounding box
family_note: McStas component library compiles the tagged C interoff-lib parser into an instrument. It is a distinct engine. The 80-artifact conda environment and installed parser sources are pinned; only geometry initialization is tested, not neutron simulation.

name: rig
input_api: rut_mesh_new_from_ply(RutContext*, local filename, position attributes, status, GError**) returns RutMesh with parsed vertices and triangle indices
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle; unmodified tagged parser with mesh/GPU support replaced by observation-only stand-ins
family: Rig Rut PLY loader over bundled RPly 1.01
family_note: Separate tagged C package path, but its PLY syntax parsing uses bundled RPly 1.01, so it is not an independent parser engine from RPly or BRL-CAD. Full Cogl/Rut graphics integration is not verified.

name: mash
input_api: mash_data_new(); mash_data_load(data, MASH_DATA_NONE, local .ply filename, GError**); mash_data_get_extents
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle; tagged C loader and bundled RPly with graphics upload observed through stand-ins
family: Mash PLY loader over bundled RPly 1.01
family_note: Separate released LGPL C package, sharing RPly parser lineage with Rig, BRL-CAD and the RPly package. The tagged MASH_TYPE_DATA_LOADER header has a type alias typo corrected by preinclude during this control; full Clutter rendering is not verified.

name: sk_renderer
input_api: Read local PLY file into bytes; ply_read(bytes, length, ply_file_t*); ply_convert(vertex element, position properties, output)
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle; parsed vertex and face element counts and second X coordinate from converted vertex body
family: micro_ply standalone C parser by Nick Klingensmith
family_note: Released sk_renderer package publishes the same micro_ply.h bytes as the author’s unversioned maluoi/header-libs repository. This is one parser family, not two independent engines. Renderer GPU APIs are not involved in this standalone reader control.

name: stereokit
input_api: model_create_file(local .ply path, shader); model_subset_count; model_get_mesh; mesh_get_verts; mesh_get_inds
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle through the full native C ABI in offscreen Mesa mode; vertices and face indices observed
family: StereoKit model PLY loader over bundled micro_ply
family_note: A separate released library and public C package path over the micro_ply syntax parser family also present in sk_renderer. The public header has one unguarded C++ default argument; replay uses a one-line generated C compatibility copy without changing library source.
